zh-CN.title: 伯努利压力计算器
zh-CN.intro: 伯努利压力计算器。输入流体速度、高度与压强，按伯努利方程 p + ½ρv² + ρgh = 常量 求沿流线的压力变化，用于管道、机翼等流体压强分析。
zh-CN.desc: 伯努利压力计算器

en-US.title: Bernoulli Pressure Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute the static pressure change along a streamline from flow speed, elevation and fluid density using Bernoulli's equation p + ½ρv² + ρgh = constant, for pipe sections, airfoils and general pressure analysis.

zh-CN.title: 由压差与截面积求体积流量
zh-CN.intro: 输入入口/喉部截面积 A1、A2 与压差 ΔP、流体密度 ρ，按文丘里公式求体积流量，用于管道流量计选型与流量在线核算。
zh-CN.desc: 由压差与截面积求体积流量

en-US.title: Venturi Flow Rate Q = A₂√(2ΔP / [ρ(1−(A₂/A₁)²)])
en-US.intro: Compute volumetric flow rate from inlet and throat cross-section areas A₁ and A₂, differential pressure ΔP and fluid density by the Venturi equation, for flowmeter selection and online flow accounting.

zh-CN.title: 静水压力计算器
zh-CN.intro: 静水压力计算器。输入液体密度、深度与重力加速度，按 p = ρgh 求液体内部由深度产生的压强，用于水箱、堤坝与潜水设备的压力设计。
zh-CN.desc: P = ρ·g·h

en-US.title: Hydrostatic Pressure Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute the pressure generated by depth inside a standing liquid from density, depth and gravity using p = ρ·g·h, for pressure design of tanks, dams and diving equipment.

zh-CN.title: 由表面张力与曲率半径求球泡内外压差
zh-CN.intro: 输入表面张力 γ 与气泡/液滴曲率半径 R，按 ΔP = 2γ/R 计算内外压差，用于分析肥皂泡、液滴及肺泡等曲面界面因张力产生的附加压力。
zh-CN.desc: 由表面张力与曲率半径求球泡内外压差

en-US.title: Laplace Pressure ΔP = 2γ / R
en-US.intro: Compute the pressure difference across a curved interface from surface tension γ and the bubble or droplet radius of curvature R using ΔP = 2γ/R, for soap bubbles, droplets and alveolar mechanics.

zh-CN.h1: 斯托克斯沉降速度计算器
zh-CN.title: 斯托克斯沉降速度计算器
zh-CN.intro: 斯托克斯沉降速度计算器。输入颗粒半径、密度差与流体黏度，求低雷诺数下小颗粒的匀速沉降终端速度，用于悬浮液沉降与水处理设计。
zh-CN.desc: v = 2r²(ρ_p−ρ_f)g / (9μ)

en-US.title: Stokes Settling Velocity Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute the terminal settling velocity of a small sphere at low Reynolds number from particle radius, particle-fluid density difference and fluid viscosity, for suspension settling and water treatment design.

zh-CN.title: 由表面张力与管径求毛细压差
zh-CN.intro: 输入液体表面张力 γ 与毛细管内径 D，按 ΔP = 4γ/D 计算毛细压差，用于分析水在细管中上升、土壤渗流或微流控中由表面张力引起的压力变化。
zh-CN.desc: 由表面张力与管径求毛细压差

en-US.title: Capillary Pressure ΔP = 4γ / D
en-US.intro: Compute the capillary pressure difference from the liquid surface tension γ and the inner tube diameter D using ΔP = 4γ/D, for analysing water rise in fine tubes, soil seepage and surface-tension driven flow in microfluidics.

zh-CN.title: 由局部阻力系数与流速求水头损失
zh-CN.intro: 输入局部阻力系数 K、流速 v 与重力加速度 g，按 h = K·v²/(2g) 计算弯头、阀门等局部构件引起的水头损失，用于管路系统阻力汇总与水泵扬程确定。
zh-CN.desc: 由局部阻力系数与流速求水头损失

en-US.title: Minor Loss Head h = K·v² / (2g)
en-US.intro: Compute head loss caused by elbows, valves and other fittings from the minor loss coefficient K, flow velocity v and gravity using h = K·v²/(2g), for summing system resistance and sizing required pump head.

zh-CN.title: 由流速与特征长度求弗劳德数
zh-CN.intro: 输入流速 v、特征长度 L 与重力加速度 g，按 Fr = v/√(gL) 计算弗劳德数，用于判别明渠水流的缓流/急流状态及船舶、堰流模型试验的相似性。
note: Fr>1 为急流，Fr<1 为缓流。
zh-CN.desc: 由流速与特征长度求弗劳德数

note: Fr>1 为急流，Fr<1 为缓流。

en-US.title: Froude Number Fr = v / √(gL)
en-US.intro: Compute the Froude number from flow speed v, characteristic length L and gravitational acceleration g to classify subcritical or supercritical open-channel flow and check similarity in ship and weir model tests.

zh-CN.title: 由动压差求流速
zh-CN.intro: 输入皮托管测得动压差 ΔP 与流体密度 ρ，按 v = √(2ΔP/ρ) 计算流体流速，用于风管、水管中借助毕托管测压测算实际流量。
zh-CN.desc: 由动压差求流速

en-US.title: Pitot Velocity v = √(2ΔP / ρ)
en-US.intro: Compute flow speed from the differential pressure measured by a Pitot tube and the fluid density using v = √(2ΔP/ρ), for flow measurement in air ducts and water pipes.

zh-CN.title: 孔口出流流量计算器
zh-CN.intro: 孔口出流流量计算器。输入孔口面积、水头与流量系数，按薄壁孔口自由出流公式求流量，用于水箱、灌溉与泄流设施的设计核算。
zh-CN.desc: Q = C_d·A·√(2·ΔP/ρ)

en-US.title: Orifice Discharge Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute discharge through a sharp-edged orifice under free outflow from the orifice area, driving head and discharge coefficient, for design checks on tanks, irrigation outlets and spillway structures.

zh-CN.title: 连续性方程计算器
zh-CN.intro: 连续性方程计算器。输入截面面积与流速，按 A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ 求不可压缩流体在变截面管道中的流速变化，用于流量守恒与管径设计。
zh-CN.desc: 连续性方程计算器

en-US.title: Continuity Equation Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute flow speed change across sections of varying area for an incompressible fluid using A₁v₁ = A₂v₂, supporting flow conservation checks and pipe diameter design.

zh-CN.title: 泊肃叶流量计算器
zh-CN.intro: 泊肃叶流量计算器。输入管径、压差与黏度，按泊肃叶定律求圆管层流体积流量，用于微流控、血液流动与润滑系统的层流分析。
note: 流量对半径极敏感（四次方）。
zh-CN.desc: Q = π·ΔP·r⁴ / (8·μ·L)

note: 流量对半径极敏感（四次方）。

en-US.title: Poiseuille Flow Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute the laminar volumetric flow rate through a circular pipe from pipe diameter, pressure drop and viscosity by Poiseuille's law, for microfluidics, blood flow and lubrication analysis.

zh-CN.title: 由摩擦系数与流速求管道压降
zh-CN.intro: 输入摩擦系数 f、管长 L、管径 D、密度 ρ 与流速 v，按达西公式求沿程压降，用于管路水力计算与泵选型能耗评估。
zh-CN.desc: 由摩擦系数与流速求管道压降

en-US.title: Darcy Pressure Drop ΔP = f·(L/D)·(ρv²/2)
en-US.intro: Compute the friction pressure drop along a straight pipe from friction factor f, length L, diameter D, density ρ and velocity v using the Darcy formula, for pipe network hydraulics and pump energy estimation.

zh-CN.title: 曼宁公式流速计算器
zh-CN.intro: 曼宁公式流速计算器。输入水力半径、底坡与糙率系数，按曼宁公式求明渠均匀流平均流速与流量，用于河道、排水沟与渠道水力设计。

en-US.title: Manning Formula Velocity Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute the mean velocity and discharge of uniform open-channel flow from hydraulic radius, bottom slope and roughness coefficient using the Manning formula, for river, drainage ditch and canal design.

zh-CN.title: 由压力与流速求空化数
zh-CN.intro: 输入当地压力 p、饱和蒸气压 p_v、密度 ρ 与流速 v，求空化数以判断泵、螺旋桨等水力机械发生空蚀的风险与工况。
note: σ 越小越易空化（σ<1 危险）。
zh-CN.desc: 由压力与流速求空化数

note: σ 越小越易空化（σ<1 危险）。

en-US.title: Cavitation Number σ = (p − p_v) / (½ρv²)
en-US.intro: Compute the cavitation number from local pressure p, saturation vapour pressure p_v, fluid density ρ and flow speed v to judge cavitation and erosion risk in pumps, propellers and other hydraulic machinery.

zh-CN.title: 由流速、尺度与表面张力求韦伯数
zh-CN.intro: 输入密度 ρ、流速 v、特征长度 L 与表面张力 σ，求韦伯数评估液滴破碎、喷雾与气泡行为，用于雾化、化工与多相流分析。
note: We 表征惯性力/表面张力。
zh-CN.desc: 由流速、尺度与表面张力求韦伯数

note: We 表征惯性力/表面张力。

en-US.title: Weber Number We = ρv²L / σ
en-US.intro: Compute the Weber number from density ρ, velocity v, characteristic length L and surface tension σ to assess droplet breakup, atomisation and bubble behaviour in sprays and multiphase flow.

zh-CN.title: 由静压与流速求驻点压力
zh-CN.intro: 驻点压力计算器。输入静压与流速，按 p₀ = p + ½ρv² 求气流停滞点的总压，用于皮托管测速、进气道与风洞试验的压力换算。
zh-CN.desc: 由静压与流速求驻点压力

en-US.title: Stagnation Pressure p₀ = p + ½ρv²
en-US.intro: Compute the stagnation (total) pressure from static pressure and flow speed using p₀ = p + ½ρv², for Pitot-based velocity measurement, inlet design and wind tunnel pressure conversion.

zh-CN.title: 由动力黏度与密度求运动黏度
zh-CN.intro: 输入动力黏度 μ 与流体密度 ρ，按 ν = μ/ρ 计算运动黏度，用于油品、涂料等流变特性标注及雷诺数计算中的黏度参数换算。
zh-CN.desc: 由动力黏度与密度求运动黏度

en-US.title: Kinematic Viscosity ν = μ / ρ
en-US.intro: Compute kinematic viscosity ν = μ/ρ from dynamic viscosity μ and fluid density ρ, for rheological specification of oils and coatings and for viscosity input in Reynolds number calculations.

zh-CN.title: 由流通面积与湿周求水力直径
zh-CN.intro: 输入非圆管道的流通截面积 A 与湿周 P，按 D_h = 4A/P 计算等效水力直径，将矩形、环形等异形截面换算为圆管以进行沿程阻力与水力计算。
zh-CN.desc: 由流通面积与湿周求水力直径

en-US.title: Hydraulic Diameter D_h = 4A / P
en-US.intro: Convert a non-circular conduit to an equivalent round pipe by computing hydraulic diameter D_h = 4A/P from flow area A and wetted perimeter P, for friction and hydraulic calculations on rectangular and annular sections.

zh-CN.title: 由谢才系数、水力半径与底坡求流速
zh-CN.intro: 输入谢才系数 C、水力半径 R 与渠道底坡 S，按 v = C√(R·S) 计算明渠或管道的均匀流流速，用于排水沟、河道与灌溉渠道的水力设计校核。
zh-CN.desc: 由谢才系数、水力半径与底坡求流速

en-US.title: Chezy Velocity v = C√(R·S)
en-US.intro: Compute uniform-flow velocity from the Chezy coefficient C, hydraulic radius R and channel bottom slope S using v = C·√(R·S), for hydraulic checking of drains, rivers and irrigation canals.

zh-CN.title: 体积流量计算器
zh-CN.intro: 体积流量计算器。输入管道截面积与平均流速，按 Q = A·v 求体积流量，用于供水、通风与化工管道的流量核算。
zh-CN.desc: Q = A·v

en-US.title: Volumetric Flow Rate Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute volumetric flow rate from pipe cross-section area and mean flow velocity using Q = A·v, for flow accounting in water supply, ventilation and chemical process piping.

zh-CN.title: 毛细上升高度计算器
zh-CN.intro: 毛细上升高度计算器。输入液体表面张力、接触角与毛细管半径，按 Jurin 定律求液体在细管中的上升高度，用于土壤、纸张与微流体中的毛细现象分析。
note: 水在细玻管中明显上升。
zh-CN.desc: h = 2γ·cosθ / (ρ·g·r)

note: 水在细玻管中明显上升。

en-US.title: Capillary Rise Height Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute how far a liquid rises inside a narrow tube from surface tension, contact angle and tube radius by Jurin's law, for soil physics, paper wicking and microfluidic capillary effects.

zh-CN.title: 阿基米德浮力计算器
zh-CN.intro: 阿基米德浮力计算器。输入排开流体的密度与体积，按 F = ρgV 求物体所受浮力，适用于船舶、浮标与浸没物体的受力分析。
zh-CN.desc: F_b = ρ_f·g·V

en-US.title: Archimedes Buoyancy Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute the buoyant force acting on an immersed or floating body from the density of the displaced fluid and the displaced volume using F = ρ·g·V, for ships, buoys and submerged structures.
